summary: Added and verified the gated real-host removal suite (tests/integration/remove.test.ts): default removal keeps the labelled volume and its data (read back from the volume mountpoint) while deleting container, image, workspace and app directory, re-add returns the same bytes over HTTP, --volumes deletes only the labelled app volume, and an unlabelled name-pattern volume is reported and never deleted. typecheck, lint, 787 unit tests, and EASY_HOST_INTEGRATION=1 npm run test:integration -- tests/integration/remove.test.ts (4/4, exit 0, 264s) pass; host audit after cleanup shows no container, volume, image, daemon, or temp root. Fixed the harness's test:integration script so an appended suite path actually scopes the run instead of silently running every gated suite (attempt 2's failure), and removed the orphaned daemon/temp root from the superseded run.

decisions: Scenarios drive runRemoveCommand (CLI exit code, stdout summary, stderr phases) for the removal contract, and addApp for the real clone/build/run/probe setup.

Data retention is proven twice: bytes read from the retained volume's mountpoint after removal, and bytes returned over HTTP by a re-added container on the same volume (same CreatedAt) - no assertion trusts a volume listing.
Every 'only the app volume' claim compares the full host volume set before and after: default removal must delete none, --volumes must delete exactly the labelled app volume.
The unlabelled foreign volume uses the app volume's exact name prefix plus '-foreign', so the refusal path is exercised on both a default and a --volumes removal.
An unlabelled volume with the app's name pattern is refused and reported; cleanup owns and deletes it afterwards.
interfaces: tests/integration/remove.test.ts consumes addApp, runRemoveCommand, createPaths, createBuildkit, containerName, volumeName, APP_LABEL/ROLE_LABEL/IMAGE_LABEL, Registry; no product interface changed.

Real builds ran on x86_64 only; the cold fixture build is network-dependent (Railpack/BuildKit acquisition), 264s with a warm cache.
A SIGKILL of the runner would bypass afterAll; unique pid+time names make retries safe, but that path is reasoned, not exercised.
npm run test:packaging exits 1 with 'No test files found' because tests/packaging does not exist yet (PKG phase not built); unrelated to this change.
validationLimitations: Default-volume retention was proven against the rootless volume mountpoint and a re-added container; a host reboot is outside this suite (v0.1.0 human-run gate).
No packaging or docs suites exist yet in this repository, so those quality gates were not exercisable here.
payload.taskDescription: Add the gated integration test for removal. Add an app with a declared volume, write data into it, remove without --volumes, and assert the container, workspace, images, and app directory are gone while the volume and its data remain and are reported. Re-add the app, then remove with --volumes and assert the volume is gone. Assert an unlabelled volume with the same name pattern is not deleted.
